title: Get Authorized TTO Media Insights
content_data:
Use this endpoint to get the reporting insights of videos of a TikTok creator who has joined TikTok One (TTO). ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/tto/creator/authorized/video/list/ **Method** GET **Header** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Access token authorized by TikTok creators.
Use [/tt_user/oauth2/token/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/get-renew-or-revoke-a-creator-access-token/v1.3#item-link-Obtain%20a%20Creator%20access%20token) or [/tt_user/oauth2/refresh_token/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/get-renew-or-revoke-a-creator-access-token/v1.3#item-link-Renew%20a%20Creator%20access%20token) endpoint to get or renew an access token.| ``` **Parameters** ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |--- |--- |--- | |creator_id {Required}|string|Application specific unique ID of the TikTok account.

Pass the value of the `open_id` field returned in the response of [/tt_user/oauth2/token/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/get-renew-or-revoke-a-creator-access-token/v1.3#item-link-Obtain%20a%20Creator%20access%20token) or [/tt_user/oauth2/refresh_token/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/get-renew-or-revoke-a-creator-access-token/v1.3#item-link-Renew%20a%20Creator%20access%20token) to this field.| |video_ids|string[]|The IDs of the videos to retrieve information for.

If `video_ids` is provided, `limit` and `cursor` will be ignored.| |limit|integer|The number of videos that you want to retrieve per request.

Value range: 1-10.
Default value: 10.| |cursor|integer|Timestamp cursor.
The videos before the timestamp value in milliseconds will be returned in reverse-chronological order.
By default, the value is 0 and the most recent videos will be returned.| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request GET 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/tto/creator/authorized/video/list/?creator_id={{creator_id}}' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' (/code) ``` ## Response ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |code |number|Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix-Return Code](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1737172488964097). | |message|string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |request_id |string|The log ID of a request, which uniquely identifies the request. | |data |object|Returned data.| #|posts|object[]|List of posts within the creator's TikTok account.| ##|video_id|string|Unique identifier for the video.| ##|display_name|string|The display name (nickname) for the creator.| ##|thumbnail_url|string|Temporary URL for profile photo of the creator.
The expiration time is included in the URL after the `x-expires` parameter, in the format of an Epoch/Unix timestamp in seconds.

Validity period: around 7 days.| ##|embed_url|string|An embeddable link for this TikTok video. This URL can be used to embed the TikTok video in external websites or applications.| ##|caption|string|Video description.| ##|likes|number|Likes.
Total number of likes on the video.| ##|comments|number|Comments.
Total number of comments on the video.| ##|shares|number|Shares.
Total number of times the video has been shared.| ##|video_views|number|Video views.
The number of times viewers watched your video.| ##|favorites|number|Favorites.
The total number of times the video has been added to favorites.| ##|create_time|string|The time when the video was created, in the format of an Epoch/Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

Example: `1749206540000`.| ##|caption_hashtags|string[]|A list of hashtags that appear in the post caption. ##|mentioned_accounts|string[]|A list of the display names of TikTok accounts that have been @mentioned in the post caption. ##|collaboration_status|string|A status indicating if the post has been used as Branded Content.

Enum values:
  • `PAID_PARTNERSHIP`: Posts linked to TTO Campaign Links.
  • `CREATOR_EARNS_COMMISSION`: TikTok Shop creator earns commission from affiliate links, learn more [here](https://ads.tiktok.com/help/article/faqs-affiliate-creatives-authorization?lang=en).
  • `NONE`
    • #|has_more|boolean|Whether an additional page of data is available.

    Supported values: `true`, `false`.| #|cursor|integer|Timestamp cursor. The time value of the last item returned in milliseconds according to the current request.
    You need to use this cursor value in your subsequent request to get the remaining videos.| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "cursor": 1743739292000, "has_more": false, "posts": [ { "caption": "", "comments": 0, "create_time": "1749206540000", "display_name": "{{display_name}}", "embed_url": "{{embed_url}}", "favorites": 0, "likes": 0, "shares": 0, "thumbnail_url": "{{thumbnail_url}}", "video_id": "{{video_id}}", "video_views": 0 }, { "caption": "", "comments": 0, "create_time": "1743739292000", "display_name": "{{display_name}}", "embed_url": "{{embed_url}}", "favorites": 0, "likes": 0, "shares": 0, "thumbnail_url": "{{thumbnail_url}}", "video_id": "{{video_id}}", "video_views": 1 } ] } } (/code) ```
